payload.title: Stability-regularized wide residual datum model
payload.statement: The large improvement of the legal 64-feature datum ridge reflects useful distributed evidence, and selecting a stable feature core or training-only blend across inner folds can retain that gain while reducing shift failures without subgroup routing.
payload.evidence_for: E009 ridge_all_a25_f64 reaches 14.6352733150 RMSE, gains 0.2978674723 over E006, wins all five maps, lowers p90 to 20.8077, and outperforms every consensus candidate. The path/evidence-only branch reaches 14.7464 and wins four maps, showing a second useful formulation.
payload.evidence_against: The wide ridge wins only 15/25 outer cells and regresses spatial group 1 plus typewell groups 2/3/4. The path/evidence branch wins 13/25 cells. Wider feature selection may amplify shared bias rather than improve transfer.
payload.next_test: E010: pre-register a split-local wide-ridge comparator, inner-fold feature-stability selector, path/evidence branch, and training-only fixed blend. No E009 subgroup threshold may enter inference. Require repeated-map, 17/25 cell, tail, every spatial/typewell group, shuffle/sign controls, runtime, final placement, packaging, and parity gates.
